data.long_meaning: Puneeth is a Sanskrit name meaning 'merciful' and 'kind'. It is derived from the Sanskrit word 'puny' meaning 'mercy, kindness, and virtue'. This name signifies the qualities of compassion, generosity, and understanding. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit. Parents who choose Puneeth usually hope their child will grow to embody merciful, kind and live with faith, good character and purpose.
